text:
Jimmy Panetta addresses coastal protection, antisemitism claims, and airport funding
S. H. Morgan
U.S. Representative Jimmy Panetta, who has served California’s 19th district in Congress since 2017, addressed a range of issues in a series of posts on August 26, 2026.
In his first post, Panetta criticized federal efforts to limit California’s environmental protections, stating on August 26: "This Administration’s attempt to strip California of its authority to protect our coastline is an attack on our coastal economy. That's why I helped lead my California colleagues to push back and continue our fight to protect the immense beauty and bounty of our home."
Later that day, Panetta responded to comments made by Hasan Piker regarding Jewish Americans and violence against the Jewish community. On August 26, he wrote, "The suggestion that Jewish Americans who publicly support Israel bear responsibility for violence against the broader Jewish community is wrong, reckless, and antisemitic. With a platform reaching millions of people, Hasan Piker’s rhetoric that blames Jews for the hatred and".
In another post from August 26, Panetta announced new federal funding for local infrastructure: "Proud to announce another $2.3 million in federal funding to support the new replacement terminal at Monterey Regional Airport. This investment will help bolster safety, efficiency, and accessibility while improving the passenger experience for residents and visitors throughout".
Panetta was born in Washington, D.C., in 1969 and currently resides in Carmel Valley. He graduated from the University of California, Davis with a BA in 1991 and earned his JD from Santa Clara University in 1996.
